The 'disease' field value 'Healthy' is an inference based on inclusion criteria and study context (no chronic disease reported), not an explicit statement; confidence set to low.
The 'feces_phenotype' mapping to 'Diarrhea' is an interpretive choice based on reported travelers' diarrhea incidence; ontology fit is uncertain.

Overall study granularity was set to 'subgroup_level' because destination (Central Africa vs Indian peninsula) subgroup differences were reported for some fields (e.g., antimalarial treatment use), while most other fields are study-level aggregates for the full cohort of 35 subjects.
Schema fields related to oncology (OS, ECOG, tumor size) are not applicable to this microbiome/antibiotic resistance travel study and were marked not_reported.
